title: aquilegia vulgaris var. corniculata
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris var. corniculata, commonly known as the 'columbine', is a type of flowering plant native to Europe and North America. The 'columbine' is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which may include reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The health benefits of Aquilegia vulgaris var. corniculata also include its potential to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of cough and cold, making it a valuable natural remedy for various ailments.
